chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

O God, have mercy upon my successors, three times. It was said to him: And who are your successors? He replied: Those who come after me and narrate my hadiths and my sunnah, so they teach it to the people after me.
ai.seo_question: Who are the successors of the Prophet according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) identifies his *khulafa'* (successors) specifically as those who preserve and transmit his hadith and sunnah, emphasizing the scholarly and narrative role over purely political authority. This definition aligns with the Shia understanding of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams as the primary transmitters of divine knowledge, establishing the chain of narration as the foundation of religious continuity. It underscores the critical importance of *riwayah* (transmission) and *dirayah* (understanding) in maintaining the authenticity of Islamic teachings after the Prophet's era.
